newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields follow Germany, close higher.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields follow Germany, close higher.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Yields took direction from a weak German market and ended higher and the spread widened to 95 basis points. The crown weakened against the mark but firmed against a falling dollar. Dollar fell on fears of an imminent German rate hike.
* Six month T-bill rate rose three basis points to 4.37 pct.
* 10-year bond yield rose five basis points to 6.64 pct.
* Crown weakened to 4.3650 against the mark versus 4.3615 crowns on Thursday.
